relationship: EnteleVAULT is a separate TVK Group ecosystem security technology project. Its capabilities may be evaluated for future use by EnteleBANK only after appropriate governance, security, resilience, legal and regulatory review.
bankStatus: EnteleBANK is a proposed UK banking institution in pre-authorisation development and is not currently authorised by the PRA or FCA to accept deposits or provide regulated banking services.
boundary: EnteleVAULT is not a bank, does not itself provide an EnteleBANK customer account or deposit product, and does not create FSCS protection or regulatory approval.
futureIntegration: Any future use by EnteleBANK must preserve clear accountability, access governance, auditability, recovery planning, supplier oversight and separation between technology services and regulated banking responsibilities.
